venue: Bybit Spot, USDT quote, long/cash, no borrowing
supported_orders: Market IOC Buy: explicit baseCoin or quoteCoin quantity
Market IOC Sell: explicit baseCoin quantity
Limit IOC Buy/Sell: base quantity and explicit tick-aligned limit

source_requirements.current_metadata: observed_metadata is inspection-only, point validity at capture, never executable or backdated
source_requirements.synthetic_rules: Explicit fixture validity; no claim about historic Bybit specifications

accounting.buy_fee: Deduct exact synthetic scenario fee from received base; cash spends gross quote only
accounting.sell_fee: Deduct exact synthetic scenario fee from received USDT
accounting.partial_fills: Require supplied typed receipts; only executed gross quantities affect balances; IOC remainder is canceled, no fill inferred from price/acknowledgement
accounting.fee_rounding: Exact decimal scenario arithmetic; real exchange fee rounding/discount rules not certified
accounting.quantity_grid: Validate requested amount in its explicit unit; retain net base-fee dust without rounding holdings
accounting.notional_submission_rule: Conservative synthetic minOrderAmt test using quantity times min(reference, explicit bound), or requested quote spend; not a claim about exchange instantaneous valuation
accounting.quote_buy_maximum: Actual cumulative base receipts must not exceed maxMarketOrderQty; no unavailable liquidity or base conversion is invented
accounting.price_bounds: Explicit caller bound; no order book or matching-engine model
accounting.nav_identity: postNAV=preNAV-fee_marked_at_reference-price_impact_at_reference; buy base fee is valued at reference, not the fill price
accounting.risk: Chronological initial/pre/post NAV peak and drawdown, including entry cost
accounting.rollback: Invalid packet changes no account state; earlier independently settled orders are not rolled back
accounting.initial_allocation: Pure helper consumes already mapped weights into floor-rounded quote budgets. It blocks unaffordable selected members, retains residual cash and never redistributes. Later rebalancing is outside scope.

input_gate.only_new_public_probe: CMC metadata ID-map sample, explicit active/inactive/untracked, no prices
